category: other: stir misdirected - blade kept beside or on the rim of the pot, pushing the pot instead of sweeping the vegetables
what_happened: Scene: layout 5, red cast-iron pot (Pot065) on a burner, toaster and spatula_9 on the counter to the right. Stage 0: potato grasped 130, dropped in the pot 238 (complete 240). Stage 1: tomato grasped 343, dropped in 474 (complete 476). Stage 2: spatula grasped 570 at the neck, lifted (complete 592/600, normal) and held to the end. Stage 3: 640-1020 (~380 steps) the gripper hovered just right of the pot at rim height with the spatula sticking out along the approach axis, blade pointing up-left over the rim, never down into the pot. From ~1040 the arm swung down on the pot's right side; the blade and fingers hit the outer wall, tilted the pot strongly (1140, pot lifted on one side) and shoved it so the lit burner's flame is exposed from 1040 on. 1200-1600 the blade stayed pressed against the outside of the pot (right/front wall). The vegetables stayed in the pot (stage 1 complete at end), but the spatula never touched them; success_time 0.
causal_chain: spatula held from 592 -> blade kept pointing up/sideways beside the pot 640-1020 -> arm came down outside the pot's right wall 1040-1600, tilting and displacing the pot -> blade never inside the pot, no contact with the vegetables -> success_time 0 at 1600
self_recovery: Kept re-approaching the pot from the right side for ~1000 steps with the spatula in hand, but never lifted the blade over the rim and into the pot.
official_criterion_notes: The packet has no pot position, so whether the pot was still within 0.15 m of the task burner after 1040 cannot be checked; the exposed flame shows it was displaced, but the blade never touched the vegetables anyway.

packet_facts: stage1 complete at end (breaks 1112-1187 while the pot was pushed)

uncertain_about: Whether the blade ever dipped into the pot during 1200-1440 (the agent view is partly occluded by the arm); the wrist view shows only the pot's outer wall.
